children.text: Along with the actual caption at the bottom of the screen, “You know what no worries”, Connor also added a second caption to the top of the video. It’s different from the one he put in the bottom caption but still cohesive. Adding a caption to the top of the video in pretty big text, gives the viewer an idea of the overall feel of the video right from the start. It sets the tone for the remainder of the post. It’s also very eye-catching. You naturally read that caption before reading the much smaller caption at the bottom. With such short attention spans in audiences now, it’s important to hook them and keep them hooked on your posts. Utilizing a much larger, more captivating caption at the top of the video grabs viewers’ attention, sets the tone for the video, and gains more traction overall.
